scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/business-hub --filter @workspace/api-server --if-present run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev
scripts.dev:web: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PORT=18500 BASE_PATH=/ API_PORT=8080 pnpm --filter @workspace/business-hub run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
